# DataGridTreeSortMode

`Flare.Components.DataGridTreeSortMode`

How tree rows are sorted when a sortable column header is clicked.

## Values

| Name | Value | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `Hierarchical` | `0` | Sort each group of siblings; children stay under their parent. |
| `Flat` | `1` | Sort the flattened visible rows as one list (the behavior before 0.55). |
